                                            theorem L4YAML.Proofs.EmitterScannability.recmapbody_navigator_driver (tokens : Array (Positioned YamlToken)) (G : Nat → Nat → Prop) (h_hi_sz : ∀ (lo hi : Nat), G lo hi → hi < tokens.size) (locate : ∀ (lo hi : Nat), G lo hi → (∀ (lo' hi' : Nat), hi' - lo' < hi - lo → G lo' hi' → RecMapBody (List.drop lo' (List.take hi' tokens.toList))) → ∃ (m : Nat), lo < m ∧ m ≤ hi ∧ (m = hi ∨ tokens[m]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry) ∧ RecMapPair (List.drop lo (List.take m tokens.toList))) (descend_tail : ∀ (lo hi m : Nat), G lo hi → lo < m → m < hi → tokens[m]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry → G (m + 1) hi) (lo hi : Nat) :
                                            G lo hi → RecMapBody (List.drop lo (List.take hi tokens.toList))

                                            The map locate DRIVER (Phase J, map side — (i'-b-B2c-desc-map-navigator-driver), R528). The symmetric mirror of recseqbody_navigator_driver (the R264 entry-boundary-input-shape split [[ref-entry-boundary-input-shape-split]] across the map axis): the seq driver named a collection-specific deliverable type (RecSeqEntry/RecSeqBody, via recseqbody_window_assemble), so by that discriminator the map axis re-splits and owes this brick. The map structural moves are complete (DESCEND recmapbody_window_of_located_entry, ADVANCE recmapbody_cons_window, TERMINATE recmapbody_single_window, and their selector recmapbody_window_assemble), and the abstract width-recursion plumbing is the shared windowWidth_strongRecOn. This brick stitches them: it instantiates the combinator at P := fun lo hi => RecMapBody ((tokens.toList.take hi).drop lo), bakes in the recmapbody_window_assemble consumer, and re-expresses the per-window step as the navigator's contract — so the whole map navigator now reduces to exactly two named obligations:

                                            • locate — the per-window first-PAIR classify: given the guard G lo hi and the recursion's own width-oracle (delivering RecMapBody for nested descent), locate the first pair's depth-0 extent m, the marker m = hi ∨ tokens[m] = .flowEntry, and the pair RecMapPair ((take m).drop lo). The pair's interior splits into a key and a value sub-block, each owing a single RecSeqEntry — supplied by recseqentry_whole_window_seq (R527) on the R524 sub-block windows (the seq dispatch reused under a no-interior-boundary certificate). The genuine remaining knot is the cross-deliverable IH source: the width-oracle here delivers RecMapBody, but a nested sequence inside a key/value needs RecSeqBody — resolved by a joint P dispatched on the window close token (recseqbody_navigator_driver consumes the seq half).
                                            • descend_tail — the guard descends from [lo, hi) to the suffix window [m+1, hi) past a depth-0 .flowEntry separator ([[ref-guard-threading-skeleton-before-grammar]], the producer's GIFT / consumer's DEBT [[ref-guarded-universal-fold-relocates-guard]]); RecMapBody's separator is the same .flowEntry as RecSeqBody's, so this obligation is collection-agnostic and its skeleton is the seq side's verbatim.

                                            The guard G is left abstract, exactly as on the seq side: the driver is agnostic to its definition, making visible that the hard guard-reconciliation reduces to locate + descend_tail and nothing else. This is [[ref-fold-consumer-chain-to-producer-contract]] at the recursion-driver layer, the dual of windowWidth_strongRecOn's [[ref-consumer-joint-before-producer]]. The proof is the seq driver transported verbatim — same windowWidth_strongRecOn refine, same locate/oracle destructure, same recmapbody_window_assemble selector, same resolve_left/descend_tail advance — swapping only the deliverable types (RecMapBody/RecMapPair for RecSeqBody/RecSeqEntry) and the assembler (recmapbody_window_assemble for recseqbody_window_assemble); the marker token and tail-oracle guard are shared, so this is a pure mirror with no new analytical content. Verified-but-unconsumed until the concrete G/locate/descend_tail are supplied (R528): composes only windowWidth_strongRecOn + recmapbody_window_assemble, references no sorry site, frontier sorry count unchanged at 4; axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (Classical via the reused recmapbody_window_assemble segment-split plumbing), identical to the seq driver.

                                            theorem L4YAML.Proofs.EmitterScannability.recbody_joint_navigator_driver (tokens : Array (Positioned YamlToken)) (G : Nat → Nat → Prop) (h_hi_sz : ∀ (lo hi : Nat), G lo hi → hi < tokens.size) (locate_seq : ∀ (lo hi : Nat), G lo hi → tokens[hi]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd → (∀ (lo' hi' : Nat), hi' - lo' < hi - lo → G lo' hi' → (tokens[hi']!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd → RecSeqBody (List.drop lo' (List.take hi' tokens.toList))) ∧ (tokens[hi']!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingEnd → RecMapBody (List.drop lo' (List.take hi' tokens.toList)))) → ∃ (m : Nat), lo < m ∧ m ≤ hi ∧ (m = hi ∨ tokens[m]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry) ∧ RecSeqEntry (List.drop lo (List.take m tokens.toList))) (locate_map : ∀ (lo hi : Nat), G lo hi → tokens[hi]!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingEnd → (∀ (lo' hi' : Nat), hi' - lo' < hi - lo → G lo' hi' → (tokens[hi']!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd → RecSeqBody (List.drop lo' (List.take hi' tokens.toList))) ∧ (tokens[hi']!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingEnd → RecMapBody (List.drop lo' (List.take hi' tokens.toList)))) → ∃ (m : Nat), lo < m ∧ m ≤ hi ∧ (m = hi ∨ tokens[m]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry) ∧ RecMapPair (List.drop lo (List.take m tokens.toList))) (descend_tail : ∀ (lo hi m : Nat), G lo hi → lo < m → m < hi → tokens[m]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry → G (m + 1) hi) (lo hi : Nat) :
                                            G lo hi → (tokens[hi]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd → RecSeqBody (List.drop lo (List.take hi tokens.toList))) ∧ (tokens[hi]!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingEnd → RecMapBody (List.drop lo (List.take hi tokens.toList)))

                                            The JOINT map+seq body navigator driver (Phase J — (i'-b-B2c-desc-joint-navigator-driver), R529), the brick that resolves the cross-deliverable IH knot the two single drivers (recseqbody_navigator_driver / recmapbody_navigator_driver, R510/R528) left open.

                                            Each single driver runs windowWidth_strongRecOn at a deliverable P fixed to ONE collection (RecSeqBody or RecMapBody), so its width-oracle delivers only that one shape. But the genuine recursion is cross-deliverable: a map pair's key/value sub-block is itself one RecSeqEntry, and a RecSeqEntry.seq stores RecSeqBody interior while a RecSeqEntry.mapRec stores RecMapBody interior — so descending into a nested sequence under a map pair (or a nested map under a seq entry) needs the OTHER body deliverable than the one the single oracle carries. A single-collection oracle cannot supply it; that is the knot.

                                            The resolution is to run ONE width-recursion at a close-token-dispatched JOINT deliverable P lo hi := (tokens[hi] = .flowSequenceEnd → RecSeqBody …) ∧ (tokens[hi] = .flowMappingEnd → RecMapBody …) — the window's close bracket selects which body it is, and the conjunction carries both implications so the oracle delivers WHICHEVER a narrower window needs. Each per-window step dispatches on the actual close token (h_seqEnd / h_mapEnd), locates the first item with the matching collection-specific locate (locate_seq → RecSeqEntry, locate_map → RecMapPair), and folds it with the matching assembler; the tail is drawn from the SAME joint oracle and projected by the SAME close token (the suffix [m+1, hi) shares the window's close tokens[hi], so its dispatch agrees — .1 h_seqEnd / .2 h_mapEnd). This is [[ref-consumer-joint-before-producer]] at the deliverable layer: bundling the two close-keyed bodies into one conjunctive P is precisely the joint that lets a single recursion feed both halves.

                                            Both single drivers are now PROJECTIONS of this one: recseqbody_navigator_driver is the .1 component (windows that close with .flowSequenceEnd), recmapbody_navigator_driver the .2. The proof is the two single-driver bodies run side by side under one refine ⟨…, …⟩, sharing the single windowWidth_strongRecOn refine and the single joint oracle — no new analytical content, the marker collapse (resolve_left ∘ omega) and descend_tail advance are the verbatim collection-agnostic stitch ([[ref-navigator-driver-stitch-two-obligations]]).

                                            Verified-but-unconsumed until the concrete G / locate_seq / locate_map / descend_tail are supplied (the locate's first-item classify is the remaining analytical work — but it now receives the joint oracle, so its key/value sub-blocks draw RecSeqBody/RecMapBody from one source): composes only windowWidth_strongRecOn + both window assemblers, references no sorry site, frontier sorry count unchanged at 4; axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (Classical via the reused assemblers' segment-split), identical to both single drivers.

                                            theorem L4YAML.Proofs.EmitterScannability.scanFiltered_emitSeq_nonempty_structure (items : Array YamlValue) (tokens : Array (Positioned YamlToken)) (h_scan : Scanner.scanFiltered ("[" ++ Emit.emit.emitList items.toList ++ "]") = Except.ok tokens) (h_ne : items.toList ≠ []) (h_all_block : ∀ (w : YamlValue), w ∈ items.toList → EmitScansInFlowBlock w) :
                                            tokens.size ≥ 5 ∧ tokens[0]!.val = YamlToken.streamStart ∧ tokens[tokens.size - 1]!.val = YamlToken.streamEnd ∧ tokens[1]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceStart ∧ tokens[tokens.size - 2]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd ∧ ((∃ (c : String), ∃ (s : ScalarStyle), tokens[2]!.val = YamlToken.scalar c s) ∨ tokens[2]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceStart ∨ tokens[2]!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingStart) ∧ (∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k < tokens.size - 2 → tokens[k]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry → ParserGrammable.flowBracketBalance tokens 2 k = 0 → k + 1 ≤ tokens.size - 2 ∧ ((∃ (c : String), ∃ (s : ScalarStyle), tokens[k + 1]!.val = YamlToken.scalar c s) ∨ tokens[k + 1]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceStart ∨ tokens[k + 1]!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingStart)) ∧ ParserGrammable.flowBracketBalance tokens 2 (tokens.size - 2) = 0 ∧ (∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k ≤ tokens.size - 2 → ParserGrammable.flowBracketBalance tokens 2 k ≥ 0) ∧ WellTyped (List.drop 2 (List.take (tokens.size - 2) tokens.toList)) ∧ (∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k + 1 < tokens.size - 2 → tokens[k]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceStart → tokens[k + 1]!.val ≠ YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd → ParserGrammable.isFlowContentStart tokens[k + 1]!.val) ∧ ∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k + 1 < tokens.size - 2 → tokens[k]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry → tokens[k + 1]!.val ≠ YamlToken.key → ParserGrammable.isFlowContentStart tokens[k + 1]!.val

                                            Token structure of scanFiltered ("[" ++ emitList items ++ "]") for non-empty items. Establishes boundary tokens, body token patterns, and parseNode success within the flow sequence body.

                                            Requires EmitScansInFlow for each item to construct the scanner chain.

                                            theorem L4YAML.Proofs.EmitterScannability.scanFiltered_emitMap_nonempty_structure (pairs : Array (YamlValue × YamlValue)) (tokens : Array (Positioned YamlToken)) (h_scan : Scanner.scanFiltered ("{" ++ Emit.emit.emitPairList pairs.toList ++ "}") = Except.ok tokens) (h_ne : pairs.toList ≠ []) (h_all_k_block : ∀ (p : YamlValue × YamlValue), p ∈ pairs.toList → EmitScansInFlowSavedKeyBlock p.fst) (h_all_v_block : ∀ (p : YamlValue × YamlValue), p ∈ pairs.toList → EmitScansInFlowBlock p.snd) :
                                            tokens.size ≥ 7 ∧ tokens[0]!.val = YamlToken.streamStart ∧ tokens[tokens.size - 1]!.val = YamlToken.streamEnd ∧ tokens[1]!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingStart ∧ tokens[tokens.size - 2]!.val = YamlToken.flowMappingEnd ∧ tokens[2]!.val = YamlToken.key ∧ (∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k < tokens.size - 2 → tokens[k]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry → ParserGrammable.flowBracketBalance tokens 2 k = 0 → k + 1 ≤ tokens.size - 2 ∧ tokens[k + 1]!.val = YamlToken.key) ∧ ParserGrammable.flowBracketBalance tokens 2 (tokens.size - 2) = 0 ∧ (∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k ≤ tokens.size - 2 → ParserGrammable.flowBracketBalance tokens 2 k ≥ 0) ∧ WellTyped (List.drop 2 (List.take (tokens.size - 2) tokens.toList)) ∧ (∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k + 1 < tokens.size - 2 → tokens[k]!.val = YamlToken.flowSequenceStart → tokens[k + 1]!.val ≠ YamlToken.flowSequenceEnd → ParserGrammable.isFlowContentStart tokens[k + 1]!.val) ∧ ∀ (k : Nat), 2 ≤ k → k + 1 < tokens.size - 2 → tokens[k]!.val = YamlToken.flowEntry → tokens[k + 1]!.val ≠ YamlToken.key → ParserGrammable.isFlowContentStart tokens[k + 1]!.val

                                            Token structure of scanFiltered ("{" ++ emitPairList pairs ++ "}") for non-empty pairs. Establishes boundary tokens, body token patterns, and parseExplicitKey/parseFlowMappingValue success within the flow mapping body.
